user_preferences.domain: Chatbot Arena head-to-head LLM conversations preference prediction
user_preferences.modality: Multi-turn text conversation paired preference modeling

architectural_constraints: Test rows contain prompt, response_a, response_b only (model_a and model_b are missing at inference)
Prompt, response_a, and response_b are JSON-serialized lists of strings (multi-turn)
Strict anti-symmetry/symmetry invariance: Swapping A and B must swap winner_model_a and winner_model_b while keeping winner_tie constant
Probabilities must be valid simplex: p >= 0, sum(p) == 1.0
Evaluation metric is Kaggle multi-class log loss with eps=auto (clipped at 1e-15)
